description_en: Initiates a major engine version upgrade task for an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 该接口用于发起RDS PostgreSQL实例大版本升级任务
name: UpgradeDBInstanceMajorVersion

parameters.help_en:
The instance type after the upgrade. The CPU and memory configurations must be greater than or equal to those of the original instance. If UpgradeMode is set to inPlaceUpgrade or zeroDownTimeUpgrade, you do not need to configure this parameter.

For example, if the original instance type is `pg.n2.small.2c` with 1 core and 2 GB of memory, you can upgrade it to `pg.n2.medium.2c` with 2 cores and 4 GB of memory.

For more information about the instance type codes of ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/276990.html
parameters.help_zh:
升级后实例规格。CPU和内存配置必须大于等于原实例规格。当UpgradeMode（升级模式）取值为inPlaceUpgrade和zeroDownTimeUpgrade时，无需配置该参数。

例如，原实例规格`pg.n2.small.2c`的CPU为1核，内存为2GB，可升级为`pg.n2.medium.2c`，CPU为2核，内存为4 GB。

RDS PG的实例规格代码，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/276990.html
parameters.name: db_instance_class

parameters.help_en:
The instance storage after the upgrade. Unit: GB. If UpgradeMode (upgrade mode) is set to inPlaceUpgrade or zeroDownTimeUpgrade, you do not need to configure this parameter.

Valid values:
PL1 ESSD: 20 GB to 3,200 GB
PL2 ESSD: 500 GB to 3,200 GB
PL3 ESSD: 1,500 GB to 3,200 GB
Premium ESSD: 40 GB to 2,000 GB

When you upgrade the major engine version of an instance with premium local SSDs, you can perform a storage capacity reduction. For more information about the minimum storage capacity that you can select, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/203309.html
parameters.help_zh:
升级后实例存储空间。单位：GB。当UpgradeMode（升级模式）取值为inPlaceUpgrade和zeroDownTimeUpgrade时，无需配置该参数。

取值范围：
ESSD PL1云盘：20 GB ~ 3200 GB
ESSD PL2云盘：500 GB ~ 3200 GB
ESSD PL3云盘：1500 GB ~ 3200 GB
高性能云盘：40 GB ~ 2000 GB

高性能本地盘实例升级大版本时，支持存储空间缩容。可选择的最小存储空间，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/203309.html
parameters.name: db_instance_storage

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Set the value to Postpaid, which indicates the pay-as-you-go billing method.

If you want to change the billing method of the instance after the upgrade, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96743.html
parameters.help_zh:
计费方式。固定配置为按量付费，取值Postpaid。


升级后如果需要变更实例的计费方式，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96743.html
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The network type of the instance after the upgrade. Set the value to VPC. Only VPC-connected instances support major engine version upgrades.

If the network type is classic network, switch the network type to VPC first. For more information about how to view or switch the network type, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96761.html
parameters.help_zh:
升级后实例网络类型。固定配置为VPC，当前只支持专有网络实例进行大版本升级。

如果网络类型为经典网络，请先切换为专有网络。关于如何查看或切换网络类型，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96761.html
parameters.name: instance_network_type

parameters.help_en:
The cutover time. This parameter is used together with the SwitchOver parameter and takes effect only when SwitchOver is set to true.

Valid values:
Immediate: The cutover takes effect immediately.
MaintainTime: The cutover takes effect within the maintenance window. You can call the ModifyDBInstanceMaintainTime operation to modify the maintenance window
parameters.help_zh:
该参数与SwitchOver配合使用，只有SwitchOver参数取值为true时有效。表示割接时间。

取值范围：
Immediate：立即生效。
MaintainTime：在可运维时间段内生效，可调用ModifyDBInstanceMaintainTime接口修改可运维时间段
parameters.name: switch_time_mode

parameters.help_en: The reserved parameter. You do not need to configure this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 预留参数，无需配置
parameters.name: switch_time

parameters.help_en:
The cutover configuration. Specifies whether to switch traffic to the new version instance based on your business requirements.

Valid values:

true: Cutover. Traffic undergoes an automatic switchover. This option is generally used to execute a formal upgrade after you confirm that your business can run stably on the new version.
false: No cutover. Traffic does not undergo an automatic switchover. This option is generally used to test the compatibility of your current business with the new version before a formal upgrade.

If you select cutover:
You cannot roll back after the cutover. Proceed with caution.
During the cutover procedure, the original instance becomes read-only and your business cannot write data. Make sure that you execute the cutover during off-peak hours.
If read-only instances are created for the original instance, you cannot select cutover. You can only upgrade the instance without cutover, and the original read-only instances are not cloned. After the upgrade is complete, you must create PostgreSQL read-only instances for the new version instance.
If you select no cutover:
Your business on the original instance is not affected during the migration.
If you upgrade the instance without cutover, you must change the database endpoint in your application to the endpoint of the new instance after the migration is complete. For more information about how to view the endpoint, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96788.html
parameters.help_zh:
割接配置，根据实际需求选择是否将流量切换到新版本实例上。

取值范围：

true：割接，自动切换。此选项一般用于在确认业务可以稳定运行在新版本之后执行正式升级。
false：不割接，不自动切换。此选项一般用于正式升级之前测试当前业务在新版本中的兼容性。

如果选择了割接：
割接后无法回退，请谨慎选择。
切换过程中，原实例会被变为只读，业务无法写入，请务必在业务低峰期进行。
如果原实例中创建了只读实例，则无法选择割接。只能通过不割接升级实例，且原只读实例不会被克隆。升级完成后，您需要在新版本实例中另行创建PostgreSQL只读实例。
如果选择了不割接：
迁移过程中，原实例的业务不会受到影响。
如需通过不割接升级实例，需在迁移完成后把应用程序中的数据库连接地址改为新实例的连接地址。如何查看连接地址，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96788.html
parameters.name: switch_over

parameters.help_en:
The time when statistics are collected for the database.
Before: Statistics are collected before the cutover. This ensures business stability. If the instance has a large data volume, the upgrade may take a long time.
After: Statistics are collected after the cutover. The instance is upgraded faster. After the upgrade, accessing tables for which no statistics are generated may result in inaccurate execution plans and even database breakdown during peak hours.

For the no-cutover scenario, collecting statistics before the cutover means collecting statistics before the new instance enables read and write operations, and collecting statistics after the cutover means collecting statistics after the new instance enables read and write operations
parameters.help_zh:
选择在哪个时间点对数据库执行统计信息收集。
Before：表示割接前收集，可以保证业务稳定性。如果实例数据量太大可能会导致升级时间较久。
After：表示割接后收集，实例升级速度较快。升级后访问未生成统计信息的表可能导致执行计划不准确，业务高峰期还可能导致数据库宕机。

对于不割接场景，割接前收集表示新实例开放读写前收集，割接后收集表示新实例开放读写后收集
parameters.name: collect_stat_mode

parameters.help_en:
The target major engine version after the upgrade. The value must be the same as the target version specified when you perform the pre-upgrade check.

You can call the UpgradeDBInstanceMajorVersionPrecheck operation to perform the pre-upgrade check for a major engine version upgrade
parameters.help_zh:
升级后实例目标大版本。必须与执行升级前检查时设置的目标版本一致。

可通过调用UpgradeDBInstanceMajorVersionPrecheck接口执行大版本升级前检查
parameters.name: target_major_version

The VPC ID. If UpgradeMode is set to inPlaceUpgrade or zeroDownTimeUpgrade, you do not need to configure this parameter.

You can call the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation to view the VPC ID of the original instance
parameters.help_zh:
VPC ID。当UpgradeMode（升级模式）取值为inPlaceUpgrade和zeroDownTimeUpgrade时，无需配置该参数。

parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The vSwitch ID of the target instance. If UpgradeMode (upgrade mode) is set to inPlaceUpgrade or zeroDownTimeUpgrade, you do not need to configure this parameter.
If the original instance is a Basic Edition instance, configure the vSwitch ID of the target instance.
If the original instance is a high availability series instance, you can configure the vSwitch IDs of the destination primary and secondary instances, separated by commas (,).

The configured vSwitch of the target instance must be in the same zone as the original instance. You can call the DescribeVSwitches operation to query the vSwitch
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例交换机ID。当UpgradeMode（升级模式）取值为inPlaceUpgrade和zeroDownTimeUpgrade时时，无需配置该参数。
当原实例为基础系列实例时，配置目标实例交换机ID。
当原实例为高可用系列实例时，可以配置目标主备实例交换机ID，使用英文逗号（,）分隔。

配置的目标实例交换机需要与原实例处于同一可用区。可调用DescribeVSwitches接口查询获取
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_zh: 无需配置，表示目标实例的内网IP。系统默认通过VPCId和vSwitchId自动分配

parameters.help_en:
The storage type of the instance after the upgrade.

Valid values:
cloud_ssd: standard SSD
cloud_essd: PL1 ESSD
cloud_essd2: PL2 ESSD
cloud_essd3: PL3 ESSD
general_essd: Premium ESSD

The major engine version upgrade feature is based on cloud disk snapshots. The following storage types are supported after the upgrade:
If the original instance uses standard SSDs, you can select standard SSDs.
If the original instance uses ESSDs, you can select PL1 ESSDs, PL2 ESSDs, PL3 ESSDs, or Premium ESSDs.
If the original instance uses premium local SSDs, you can select PL1 ESSDs, PL2 ESSDs, PL3 ESSDs, or Premium ESSDs
parameters.help_zh:
表示升级后实例的存储类型。

取值范围：
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘
cloud_essd：ESSD PL1云盘
cloud_essd2：ESSD PL2云盘
cloud_essd3：ESSD PL3云盘
general_essd：高性能云盘


版本升级功能基于云盘快照，当前升级后支持选择的存储类型如下。
当原实例为SSD云盘时，可选SSD云盘。
当原实例为ESSD云盘时，可选ESSD PL1云盘、ESSD PL2 云盘、ESSD PL3 云盘、高性能云盘。
当原实例为高性能本地盘时，可选ESSD PL1云盘、ESSD PL2 云盘、ESSD PL3 云盘、高性能云盘
parameters.name: db_instance_storage_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the destination primary zone. If UpgradeMode is set to inPlaceUpgrade or zeroDownTimeUpgrade, you do not need to configure this parameter.

You can call the DescribeRegions operation to view the zone ID.

ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL allows you to configure the new instance in a different zone within the same region as the original instance after the upgrade
parameters.help_zh:
目标主可用区ID。当UpgradeMode（升级模式）取值为inPlaceUpgrade和zeroDownTimeUpgrade时，无需配置该参数。

可以通过DescribeRegions接口查看可用区ID。

RDS PostgreSQL支持升级后将新的实例配置到与原实例同一地域的其他可用区
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the destination secondary zone. This parameter is available only when the original instance is a high availability series instance. If UpgradeMode (upgrade mode) is set to inPlaceUpgrade or zeroDownTimeUpgrade, you do not need to configure this parameter.

ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL allows you to configure the new secondary instance in a different zone within the same region as the original instance after the upgrade.

You can call the DescribeRegions operation to view the zone ID
parameters.help_zh:
仅当原实例为高可用系列时，该参数可配置，表示目标实例备可用区ID。当UpgradeMode（升级模式）取值为inPlaceUpgrade和zeroDownTimeUpgrade时，无需配置该参数。

RDS PostgreSQL支持升级后将新的备实例配置到与原实例同一地域的其他可用区。

可以通过DescribeRegions接口查看可用区ID

parameters.help_en:
The upgrade mode. If SwitchOver is set to true, you must configure this parameter. Valid values:

inPlaceUpgrade: in-place upgrade. The major engine version upgrade task is executed on the original instance, and no new version instance is created. The major engine version of the original instance is upgraded, and the original instance inherits the existing orders, instance name, tags, CloudMonitor alert rules, and backup rules.
blueGreenDeployment: blue-green deployment. The major engine version upgrade retains the original instance and creates a new version instance. The new instance is free of charge during creation, but fees are generated after the creation is successful, and the billing method may change. After the upgrade is complete, both the original instance and the new instance generate fees, and the new instance does not enjoy the discounts of the original instance.
zeroDownTimeUpgrade: zero-downtime upgrade. The system uses pg_upgrade to upgrade the original instance to the target version and implements incremental updates through native logical replication. The upgrade procedure supports manual switchover, and you can verify the higher version instance before the switchover. From the start of the upgrade to the manual switchover, the instance can maintain normal read and write operations. During the switchover, the read-only time of the instance is at the second level
parameters.help_zh:
升级模式。当SwitchOver（割接配置）取值为true时，需要配置该参数。取值：

inPlaceUpgrade：本地升级。大版本升级任务将在原实例上进行，不会创建新版本实例。升级后的原实例大版本提升，并将继承原有的订单、实例名称、标签、云监控报警规则及备份规则。
blueGreenDeployment：蓝绿部署。大版本升级会保留原实例，并创建一个新版本的实例，新实例在创建中不收费，创建成功后将会产生费用，并且计费方式可能会发生变化。升级完成后，原实例和新实例将同时产生费用，且新实例暂不享受原实例的优惠。
zeroDownTimeUpgrade：零停机。系统采用pg_upgrade将原实例升级至目标版本，并通过原生逻辑复制实现增量更新。升级过程中支持主动切换，并可在切换前对高版本实例进行验证；在升级开始至主动切换前，实例可保持正常的读写操作；在切换过程中，实例的只读时间为秒级
parameters.name: upgrade_mode
